# OCI_REGISTRY

A container registry, addressed for a human and for a node pulling an image.

<!-- Generated by nix/signature-docs.nix from nix build .#referencePages -->

Canonically `registry`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.registry`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.

## Fields

| field | type |
| --- | --- |
| credentials | null or record { name, namespace, passwordKey, usernameKey } |
| namespace | kubernetes name (DNS-1123 label) |
| pullRef | string |
| url | string |
